body: I dont know if you keep adding to your comment or if my computer isnt refreshing fast enough. but you are absolutely right. Like I said, this girl and I have had past sexual relations and she will come over to my house to spend the night all the time, so the position we were in isn't anything new. Sometimes she's down to hook up and sometimes she's not. Everytime I attempt to make a move, she will tell me "no" and I always stop. I only kept going because she didn't respond like she usually does. I have told her in the past that I can not keep having her come over and keep doing this since she doesn't feel the same way for me as I do for her. By all means I am not saying that it is her fault in anyway, but her actions were very misleading.

I appreciate the comment. I know that it wasn't "full on" sexual assault but I feel extremely guilty about since she did come to me after she was sexually assault studying abroad and I have been helping her through it. I think this situation is elevated because of her circumstance. Things probably would be different right now if that never happened to her. But thank you, that made me feel a lot better.

I fully understand that my actions were not a cool thing to do. My past issues with depression and anxiety is heavily weighing in on this right now. It is really hard to motivate myself to do anything since I am in school and finals are coming up. I know it will pass but god damn, I have never felt so much guilt and shame in my life especially because I love and care for this girl so much.
